name: Industrias J.B. Duarte S.A.
summary: Indústrias J. B. Duarte S/A operates as an investor company. The company was formerly known as José Batista Duarte and changed its name to Indústrias J. B. Duarte S/A in April 1936. Indústrias J. B. Duarte S/A was founded in 1914 and is based in São Paulo, Brazil.
